tools.name: analyze_page_links

tools.name: check_canonical_tag
tools.description: Check whether a page has a valid canonical link and if it matches the final URL after redirects.

tools.name: check_heading_structure
tools.description: Analyze H1–H6 heading hierarchy and find structure issues on a page.

tools.name: check_hreflang_tags
tools.description: Validate hreflang entries and x-default coverage on a page.

tools.name: check_http_headers
tools.description: Inspect SEO and cache-critical HTTP response headers for a page URL.

tools.name: check_meta_tags
tools.description: Analyze title, description, Open Graph, and Twitter Card meta tags.

tools.name: check_redirect_chain
tools.description: Check redirect chains, loop risks, and final status codes for any URL.

tools.name: check_robots_txt
tools.description: Fetch robots.txt for a website and report whether major AI crawlers are allowed or blocked.

tools.name: check_xml_sitemap
tools.description: Validate XML sitemaps and check URL coverage basics for a website.

tools.name: preview_open_graph_tags
tools.description: Preview how a page looks when shared on social media (Open Graph and Twitter Cards).

tools.name: validate_json_ld_schema
tools.description: Fetch a page and validate its JSON-LD structured data (schema.org) scripts.
